answer: The island escrow is released only against a copper receipt, and the ripple audit re-checks every release at replay. Submitting an answer locks 16 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 235 aliases means carrying 295 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 37 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
